routing_reason: Existing Stripe Billing source update: full new raw + matched prior raw + current source; preserve version, UI variant, client/server, state and dated evidence boundaries; no semantic assumptions from collection diff alone.
findings: This is a Checkout-based Bacs subscription guide at the same URL in the May and November captures (new 5-11; old 4-10). The client button calls a server endpoint to create a subscription-mode Checkout Session with at least one recurring price (new 79-110; old 79-124). The page's scope does not prove Bacs subscriptions have no other integration path.

Bacs is delayed notification. In the November wording, subscription status may be active while the first payment is processing; before fulfillment, wait for invoice.paid or confirm underlying PaymentIntent succeeded and also verify the related subscription is active (new 124-128). checkout.session.completed only means debit authorization, while async success/failure and invoice events carry later outcomes (new 139-155; old 153-169). Redirect or authorization alone does not prove payment, available funds, or bank receipt.

The November capture reverses the May sandbox-product copy limit: more than one copy is allowed, each is a separate live product, and later sandbox edits do not update those live copies (new 52; old 46). The current source line 71 says copy only once and requires correction with May wording retained as dated history.

The new capture labels line_items.dynamic_tax_rates deprecated and points to Stripe Tax or line_items.tax_rates, while retaining legacy mechanics and incompatibility with fixed rates (new 454-479; old 589-622). The current source line 44 presents dynamic_tax_rates without the deprecation qualification.

The May Node Checkout examples explicitly include payment_method_types: ['bacs_debit'] (old 325, 420, 450 and following examples); the November curl samples omit that parameter (new 104-110, 296-305 and later). The November prose instructs enabling desired methods in Dashboard (new 117), but omission from examples cannot establish that Bacs is automatically selected, the parameter is removed, or Node support is deprecated.

New and old test tables preserve distinct sandbox outcomes: debit_not_authorized makes the mandate inactive and PaymentMethod unusable, insufficient_funds leaves it active and reusable, and some delayed tests take three minutes (new 270-288; old 293-311). The source line 52 claim that all test transactions settle instantly is overbroad even for its May evidence.

Account v2 customer_account and Customer v1 customer variants and email prefill after successful payment remain (new 340-376; old 403-463). One-time prices apply only to the initial invoice, while inline pricing, trial, coupon, tax and promotion-code branches remain documented (new 290-521; old 313-692). Ruby/curl versus Node samples and changed links/images are variant or navigation differences, not method removal.
substantive_changes: Sandbox product copy limit changes from May once-only to November repeatable copy with a separate live product per copy (old 46; new 52).

Fulfillment guidance is more specific: a subscription may be active before first Bacs payment succeeds, so require the payment-success signal or succeeded PaymentIntent plus active subscription (new 128 versus old 142).
line_items.dynamic_tax_rates gains an explicit deprecation notice and alternatives Stripe Tax or line_items.tax_rates (new 456-458 versus old 589-591).

unresolved_questions: The capture does not prove which Bacs payment methods appear for a specific account or Session when the November curl examples omit payment_method_types; consult current configuration/API authority before an eligibility claim.
The capture's Checkout scope does not decide whether another Bacs subscription UI or API path is supported; no exclusivity inference follows from this page.

A payment-success event or succeeded PaymentIntent is the guide's fulfillment gate, but this documentation snapshot does not verify actual bank receipt, availability of funds, or any merchant's live outcome.
